brief.headline: Push from ₹1067.36/KG to ₹250/KG — the price Silk Polypack gives us and the top of the fair market band.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250/KG on LAMINATE, down from ₹1067.36/KG
priceAsk.basis: Silk Polypack already supplies us at ₹250/KG, and the market ask for pharma/ORS sachet laminate puts ₹250/KG at the top of the fair band (₹205–305/KG). Huhtamaki's price is 326.9% higher; closing that gap saves us ₹58850 a year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki is healthy — revenue of ₹2755.75 Cr, they keep ₹4.7 of every ₹100 they sell, debt is very low at 0.11x equity, and their sales are growing fast at 23.1% a year. But we are tiny to them: our ₹76850 spend is 0.00% of their revenue, so we have almost no pull on our own. The play is to use Silk Polypack's ₹250/KG as proof that our current price is out of line, offer to commit more volume since they're growing and hungry for orders, and quietly line up UFLEX or Constantia Parikh as a second source so Huhtamaki knows we can walk.

evidence.point: Silk Polypack supplies the same laminate to us at ₹250/KG
Market ask for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/KG, typical ₹250/KG — verdict: MARKET-FAIR (top of fair band)
Closing the gap to ₹250/KG saves us ₹58850 a year
We are 0.00% of their ₹2755.75 Cr revenue — minimal pull
Their sales are growing at 23.1% a year — they want new orders

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant doing both film and conversion at scale; can second-source laminates. Revenue ₹16492.00 Cr, health C (46/100).

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter for pharma blister/sachet laminates; strong second-source. Revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health D (31/100).

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Amcor's India arm — high-end pharma laminates; premium but very reliable. Financials not public.

risks: We are only 0.00% of their revenue — Huhtamaki may ignore us unless we bundle more volume or commit long-term.
Silk Polypack at ₹250/KG is our only internal benchmark; if that supplier can't scale or Huhtamaki questions their quality/specs, our price case weakens — qualify UFLEX or Constantia fast.
Huhtamaki's health is decent (C 58/100) and debt is low (0.11x) — they are not desperate and can afford to walk away from a tiny customer.
Growing at 23.1% a year means they are busy; a ₹76850 account may not be worth their sales team's time unless we offer a multi-year commitment or much higher volume.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about the LAMINATE price — right now we're paying you ₹1067 a kilo, but Silk Polypack gives us the same thing at ₹250, which sits right at the top of the market's fair band.
